title: BTCPay offers $190,000 bounty after bitcoin payment servers drained in exploit
summary: The project said it will pay 10% of recovered funds, up to 3 BTC, after attackers stole LND credentials and drained merchant Lightning wallets last week.

title: Bitcoin’s BIP-110 fork is 300 blocks behind BTC and six years from fixing itself
summary: The breakaway chain has produced two blocks since splitting off on Saturday. Bitcoin has produced more than 300 in the same stretch.

title: XRP, ether lead crypto losses as traders eye $70,000 bitcoin next
summary: Bitcoin failed to hold $65,000 for a fourth day as an oil rally revived inflation worries before Wednesday's U.S. price data.

title: U.S. SEC sets meeting to propose Reg Crypto to support certain digital assets offerings
summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission will vote this week to start its first major crypto rulemaking process.

title: Bitcoin's 'strongest hands' are back, on-chain data show
summary: Elite wallets holding over 10,000 BTC has hit a six-month high of 90, building on earlier accumulation by mid-sized whales amid Coldcard fallout and Clarity Act delays.
